ai_summary: Cyient DLM Limited reported an exceptionally strong Q1 FY27, showcasing substantial year-on-year growth across revenue (+34.3%), EBITDA (+56.2%), and PAT (+118.2%), with EBITDA margins consistently in double digits for four consecutive quarters. The company achieved a record INR 26 billion order book and a robust 1.5x book-to-bill ratio, providing significant revenue visibility and validating its strategic focus on high-reliability, high-margin segments like aerospace and industrial, with planned expansion into AI infrastructure and robotics. Although geopolitical uncertainties cause minor logistical and cost impacts, these are being managed, with the only notable watchpoint being an increase in working capital days attributed to supporting future growth.
